# Solar panel quote comparison

Three installers quoted a rooftop solar system for the house. Quote A: 6.4 kW with microinverters, 25-year warranty. Quote B: 7.2 kW with a string inverter and battery-ready wiring. Quote C: 5.8 kW, cheapest, but only a ten-year workmanship warranty.

The payback period is about nine years for A and B. Net metering rules from the utility changed this year, so a home battery shortens payback less than the installers claim.
